babel.configuration.title: Babel Configs
gui.babel.collectibles.title: Collectibles
gameplay.babel.n_6: Attention: §eYou've switched to a high difficulty for Caerula Arbor, please take care.
gameplay.babel.n_12: Warn: §cYou've switched to a very high difficulty for Caerula Arbor, it isn't for normal survival games.
gameplay.relic_ban.notice.0: Advanced relics are banned in this world.
gameplay.relic_ban.notice.1: This notice will only be shown once.
gameplay.life_point.revive.0: Your've well dined and revives {num} Life Point!
gameplay.life_point.revive.1: You've tasted delicacies and revives {num} Life Point!
gameplay.life_point.revive.2: You've gotten pleaseure eating and revives {num} Life Point!
item.babel.originium_iris_flower.descrip: A most extravagant bouquet of flowers. The troupe leader has handed flowers like these to the leads during countless curtain calls.
item.babel.omnikey.description_0: Player get 3 levels of exp when used
item.babel.omnikey.description_1: An old, silver key. It can open any door. As the keeper, the troupe's butler naturally needs a key that unlocks all the secrets here.
item.babel.gold_expedition.description_0: Gain 6 experience levels and 12 gold ingots when used
item.babel.gold_expedition.description_1: From wasteland first the queen did start, beneath her gown markets sprung like spring's own heart, wealth's roads through mountains tall, forests profound, till she vanished where western waves kiss the bound.
item.babel.piglin_diary.description_1: From which we can learn the ideas of piglins about overworld
item.babel.kettle.description_0: Player Maxhealth +1 and +1 experience level when used
item.babel.kettle.description_1: Some people often use the water boiler in the Rhodes Island Office to cook instant noodles in the middle of the night. That's not a very healthy lifestyle...
item.babel.vampires_bed.description_1: A lavish-looking coffin that matches the castle's aesthetics well. However, Warfarin says this is merely a stereotype.
item.babel.pitts_assorted_fruits.descrip: Gain Strength II, Resistance II and Healthboost II when eaten
Pitt's assorted fruit candies compete with Mama John's line of products in the sweets market with a rich taste and superb cost-effectiveness. Muelsyse's favorite.
death.attack.true_damage: %1$s was killed by %2$s with true damage
death.attack.true_damage.player: %1$s was killed by %2$s with true damage
item.babel.hand_of_buckler.description_0: Player deals extra magic damage of 3% of the target's current health when attacking with a hoe or hitting with a tipped arrow
item.babel.hand_of_buckler.description_1: Drop by drop, bit by bit. It is unstoppable.
item.babel.hand_of_thorns.description_0: Damage attack for 50% of your armor
item.babel.hand_of_thorns.description_1: Let the enemy make his own move. He will be his own downfall.
item.babel.hand_of_strangle.description_: Instakill mobs whose health under 20% if hit by crossbow
With your last strength, break open a last bit of hope for yourself.
item.babel.hand_of_speed.description_0: Attack speed +1.8 when no allies nearby; gain Haste III additionally when using a pickaxe
item.babel.hand_of_speed.description_1: You swing your hand, leaving not even an afterimage.
item.babel.hand_of_firework.description_: Player shoot with bow got 25% chance to deal 200% AoE damage to the target
item.babel.hand_of_swipe.description_0: When holding a brush in offhand or having Regeneration, deals magic damage to surrounding mobs
item.babel.hand_of_swipe.description_1: Where it is, dust is not.
item.babel.hand_of_protraction.descripti: Gains +25% attack damage every 30 seconds within an active beacon's range, stacking up to 5 times; after leaving the range for 8 seconds, the bonus decays linearly by 5% per second
item.babel.chitinous_ripper.description_: On attack, 5% chance to gain +100% attack damage and +100% max health for 20 seconds
A more efficient way of growing an exoskeleton. It can tear prey apart, resist impact, and also be turned into a delicacy for its kin.
item.babel.fearless_blade.description_0: On attack, 5% chance to gain +50% attack damage and +50% armor for 15 seconds
item.babel.fearless_blade.description_1: Before Kazdel's gates he stood, an impregnable bulwark. Gaulish artilleries, Leithanian casters, and Victorian Knights all took their shots at him. Yet, even when the gates fell and the coalition retreated, the Goliath did not yield an inch.
item.babel.devotion.description_0: On attack or heal, deal 3 magic damage to a random enemy within 12 blocks
item.babel.devotion.description_1: Since antiquity, this tribe has believed that they hold a truth about Sami: Everything originally had a voice, until \"It\" spoke for all of them.
item.babel.white_flower_crown.descriptio: Healing and health regeneration the player receives are increased by 30%
A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving nothing only a pale white color.
item.babel.presence_necklace.description: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.
item.babel.revolver_cylinder.description: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.
item.babel.leithanian_honor_medal.descri: The twin empresses rarely do anything together, but conferring awards on those who create art is one such thing.
item.babel.conval_experience_card.descri: Attack speed +25% while the player has Regeneration
A special service from the Convalescent Garden!' Each Operator is entitled to one physiotherapy session from the Convalescent Garden before each of their field operations. Non-transferrable.
item.babel.rusted_iron_hammer.descriptio: Originium prices -50% when buying collectibles from Cannot Goodenough's shop
\"Change is necessary, and we must do all we can to hasten the oncoming storm.\"
item.babel.conval_prime_membership.descr: Attack speed +45% while the player has Regeneration

A special service collaboratively provided by the Convalescent Garden and the Medical Department! Each Operator is entitled to one comprehensive physical and psychological assessment, as well as a physiotherapy session. Afterwards, they can also taste Podenco's homemade flower cakes.
item.babel.silver_forks.description_1: One for dealing with actors who botch their performances, one for dealing with incompetent playwrights, and one for anyone who needs it. The Chief will not tolerate any mistakes on the table.
item.babel.first_aid_kit.description_1: \"...Please use antibiotics and ethanol additives under the supervision of professionals...\" —Rim Billiton Production Safety Manual
item.babel.the_silence.description_1: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. \"The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.\"
item.babel.vieux_vanguards_blade.descrip: The player deals 35% more melee attack damage
Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.
item.babel.fowlbeast_liver_pate.descript: A small jar of fowlbeast liver pâté. Bright and vividly colorful, it is eaten only by nobles.
item.babel.vanilla_soda.description_1: Bolívar's cheap specialty drink dates back hundreds of years. It is mixed with a variety of spices, and is known for not being very good.
item.babel.actor_perfume.description_0: The player regenerates 5% of their max. health every 5 seconds
item.babel.actor_perfume.description_1: Troupe actors put this on before going onstage. Stable yet aromatic fragrances like this can help them ease pressure. That's how it seems on the surface, at least.
item.babel.dreambind_castle_model.descri: The player can attack sleeping units, dealing 175% damage to them
You've seen this place, and you once wandered the castle, yet you now hold it in your hand. Is this real, or is it all a dream?
item.babel.dreaming_essence.description_: Supposedly the Banshees make their aromatics only for their beloved. A single drop is enough to enchant just about anyone, bringing out any artist's inspiration and creativity.
item.babel.carriage_whip.description_0: Nearby enemy units take 25% more physical damage
item.babel.carriage_whip.description_1: As the troupe's carriage driver, he has no name and no past. His life is meaningful only when he whips his burdenbeasts.
item.babel.children_puppet.description_0: Enemies take 7.5 magic damage per second while stunned, frozen, or bound
item.babel.children_puppet.description_1: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.
item.babel.second_economic_reform_act.de: Grants the Hero of the Village effect for 5 minutes on use
With this bill as the starting point, Gaul formally began its path to become a hegemonic empire.
item.babel.royal_rapier.description_0: The player deals 25% more melee attack damage
item.babel.royal_rapier.description_1: A highly decorative rapier for nobles. Used by Gaulish nobles first and foremost, though perhaps a little fragile for a military weapon.
item.babel.avenger.description_0: Nearby enemy units take 35% more physical damage
item.babel.avenger.description_1: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Council.
item.babel.unknown_instrument.descriptio: Don't ask. It's for your own good.
item.babel.supreme_ring.description_1: In Leithanian mythology, he who holds the ring enjoys the vast riches of the entire world, but greed will also be his undoing.
item.babel.hand_of_sword.description_0: Enemies armor and toughness -70% for 6s when hit, player revive 7.5% health simultaneously
item.babel.hand_of_engrave.description_0: Everytime when player kill with a trident or axe, he gets 1% addition of attack and max health, only functions with a trident or axe
item.babel.hand_of_snatcher.description_: 10% chance to gain an emerald for each enemy killed, movement speed +10% while having Hero of the Village
Whatever it is you do not have, snatch it away from your enemy. There is no need to hesitate.
item.babel.hand_of_diffusion.description: Channeling restores 1 hunger point per enemy hit (also allows channeling in rain while active)
The more enemies you strike, the more power you take hold of.
item.babel.king_crown.description_0: Player attack +50% when target life is 1 or lower, boosted to +150% with three King relics gathered
item.babel.king_crown.description_1: O Nameless King, may you continue to bless Iberia, even should your kingdom fall to ruin.
item.babel.king_staff.description_0: Restores 1 hunger point every 16 seconds when only one Life left
item.babel.king_staff.description_1: Let go of worthless pomp and treat others with kindness. They will no doubt return in kind.
item.babel.king_fellowship.description_0: Shield +2, all Life is converted into equal shield (Life will not go below 1)
item.babel.king_fellowship.description_1: The Cultists of the Deep did not achieve success overnight; they lingered at the junction between the land and sea for ages, preparing for the calamity that would come to be known as the Profound Silence.
item.babel.king_buckler.description_0: Melee damage taken -20% when only one Life left
item.babel.king_buckler.description_1: Keep your eyes straight ahead, and let your stalwart heart resist all hardship.
item.babel.sarkaz_king_bed.description_0: When Life is full, player armor +3, amr toughness +2
item.babel.sarkaz_king_bed.description_1: For those in this position, a peaceful sleep becomes eternal.
item.babel.sarkaz_king_banner.descriptio: If Lif is full, player move and swim speed +30%
For those in this position, to struggle is to inevitably fall.
item.babel.sarkaz_king_artifact.descript: If Life full, Player health +50%, which boost to +150% with three Archifiend relics gathered
For those in this position, prosperity is but an illusion.
item.babel.royal_alliance_treaty.descrip: Damage from nether mobs reduce 99%, while for bosses it was 50%.
The old Sarkaz courts sacrifice themselves to obtain their power. Ever since, the courts have come to terms with one another, banding together against their common enemy.
item.babel.seagrass_salad.description_0: Gain haste I for 120s when eaten
item.babel.seagrass_salad.description_1: Once a national delicacy of great pride to the Iberians, now gradually slipping away from memory as a result of the rampaging Seaborn.
item.babel.acahuallan_bowl.description_0: Restores 4 Life Points and grants 2 Objective Shields when used
item.babel.acahuallan_bowl.description_1: Fruit is one of the locals' staples, often eaten fresh right off the tree.
item.babel.church_alms_voucher.descripti: Player health +10%, and gain Regeneration II for 25s when used

In the declining coastal towns of Iberia, certain churches will provide alms in the form of meals, which their believers can redeem using vouchers. As for how these vouchers are distributed, that is a secret.
item.babel.worn_group_photo.description_: Do you know someone in the photo?
item.babel.abyssal_wyrdmask.description_: An eldritch mask not belonging to any culture you're familiar with that is capable of making people lose their will to fight... and unconsciously fall into a state of deep contemplation.
item.babel.banshees_kiss.description_0: Gain 8 levels of exp and Regeneration I for 5s when used
item.babel.banshees_kiss.description_1: Outsiders make extraordinary displays of bravery that far surpass their normal abilities. However, as one of the few male Banshees out there, this has become a far too common sight to Logos.
item.babel.red_bow_tie.description_0: Gain 2 levels of exp and +8% attack speed when used
item.babel.red_bow_tie.description_1: The first present Phantom gave Miss.Christine. She is really fond of it.
item.babel.four_leaf_clover_fossil.descr: Doubles the chance of collectibles dropped by slain enemies

A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.
item.babel.ancient_tree_fruit.descriptio: Grants 3 random Normal-rarity collectibles when used

The children of Sami made their wishes into tree seeds, and buried them in the snow. When the tree bears fruit, the first four are taken, and the smallest is left for future generations to make their wishes. The remaining fruits are tributes to Sami, praying for answers.
item.babel.antique_casting.description_0: Immediately enchants 3 unenchanted items in your backpack when used
item.babel.antique_casting.description_1: \"Harken the forge of the sky Awaits five earthborn metals\" ...Even though it can be used for all kinds of work, nobody understands its exact mechanism.
item.babel.unleashings.description_0: When hurt: 25% to restore 1 hunger, 25% to restore 1 saturation, 20% to restore 1 health, 40% to extend a beneficial potion effect by 1 second (capped at 5 minutes)
item.babel.unleashings.description_1: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.Before an update, the description says \"After multiple tries, Touch naturally opens up to you, albeit temporarily.\"
item.babel.sheet_music.description_0: Player gain 4 levels of exp and attack speed +0.6 when used
item.babel.sheet_music.description_1: A tattered piece of sheet music. The notes can no longer be clearly read. No one knows for certain what story this piece was meant to tell.
item.babel.proof_of_longevity.descriptio: A tree branch that has withered and flourished.When it is withered, it grows anew. When it is thriving in its fullest, it fades away yet again.
item.babel.hemost.description_1: \"After fermentation, the body fluids of this Originium slug can be used to stop bleeding.\" —\"Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide\"
item.babel.solo_music_box.description_1: An old music box. The music does not play when the box is opened, nor does the figure inside show any signs it is about to move. There is not a peep, and no one is breaking out in dance. Before she begins her performances with Phantom, the lead actress stares blankly into the music box.
item.babel.toponym_textology.description: A book from librarian, which records an Ancient City
item.babel.yearning.description_0: Player health +1, toughness and knockback resistance +3% with each 2 lels of exp
item.babel.yearning.description_1: These incomplete thoughts cling to their creators, zealously guarding them until they obtain their forms through a sudden revelation and embark on a long journey.
item.babel.allay_sculpture.description_1: A hand-size  sculpture, which is said to be created by allay to convert friendlyness
item.babel.king_armor.description_0: transfer all Lives to Shield, and 10% chance to gain 1 Shield and cost 1 Life when kill a mob
item.babel.king_armor.description_1: There used to be many golden display cases placed before the palace gates and in the square, displaying all sorts of treasures to admire. But now, it hurts just to think about such sights.
item.babel.king_spear.description_0: Player attack apeed +1 if only one Life left
item.babel.king_spear.description_1: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.
item.babel.king_extension.description_0: Player gains regeneration II and extra exp when only one Life left
item.babel.king_extension.description_1: Grow up and face reality. Arm yourself with tenacity and confidence, while showing your friends tolerance and grace.
item.babel.king_crystal.description_0: 20% chance to lose 1 life and gain one level of xp and a emerals
item.babel.king_crystal.description_1: The Iberians' contact with the Seaborn goes back further than they can imagine, but they did not know what the Seaborn were back then.
item.babel.royal_fate.description_0: Shield +3, transfer MaxLife to Shield, the former set to 1
item.babel.royal_fate.description_1: Each King bears a unique fate and form.
item.babel.survivor_contract.description: When player kill a mob, he got 35% chance to get 20% addition on health and attack, and armor +2 (20 times limited)
A very long contract, in which every term and condition is the result of experience, leaving no room for chance or sentiment. Satisfy them all to be the final survivor.
item.babel.canned_cherry.description_1: Candy product by Margosha, made with cherry and wart, loved by a small crowd of people
item.babel.golden_chalice.description_0: Attack speed +7% for every 5 Originium Ingots in the backpack.
item.babel.golden_chalice.description_1: Saints, knights, and pietists. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
item.babel.black_tulip.description_0: While no critical hit lands, critical damage ramps up to +60% over 30 seconds. The bonus is consumed on each critical hit
item.babel.black_tulip.description_1: The Silence crushed the Iberians, so she wishes to speak up. If her words are not sharp enough, then her sword will speak for her.
item.babel.rock_horn.description_0: For each ally (player or their pet) within 8 blocks, attack damage +20%, up to 10 allies
item.babel.angelina_inspiration.descript: Nearby enemy units' movement speed -15%, and their weight level is reduced by one
Ajimu doesn't mind sharing her Arts. She believes you will use them in the right place.
item.babel.old_fan.description_0: Gain +10% attack damage for each type of profession item in your inventory (hoe, crossbow, bow, shield, axe, sword); each type counts only once, up to +60%
item.babel.old_fan.description_1: When it rains for several days on end, the old Yanese Tianshi complains to his friends about the pain in his knees, before casually waving his fan and driving away the rainclouds. It is about time he taught this trick to his young apprentice, currently working at the Central Judicial Office.
item.babel.rainbow_jar.description_0: After losing health or shield, gain Speed II for 15 seconds and remove one random harmful effect
item.babel.rainbow_jar.description_1: It is usually placed by the Sami people wherever the rainbow falls. They are meticulously maintained in order to withstand the untraceable catastrophes, both natural and man-made.
item.babel.oriron_round_shield.descripti: Before the use of Oriron became widespread in today's industrial sector, the material was frequently used to forge military weapons like this one.
item.babel.friston_p.description_0: Killing an elite or boss always adds 1 stack; otherwise a 15% chance. Each stack grants +0.1 attack speed (up to 15 stacks)
item.babel.friston_p.description_1: Friston would certainly not miss out on an opportunity to explore the secrets of another predecessor civilization. Oh, but Closure didn't even consider making backups, so DON'T tell her about this!
item.babel.string_puppet.description_0: Enemies stunned, frozen, or bound take 7 Arts damage per second
item.babel.string_puppet.description_1: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?
item.babel.emperor_collection.descriptio: Nearby enemy units take +30% Arts damage
The Sami revere their wild lands more than anything, and this fragment of the vast wilderness sleeps in the personal collection of the Emperor of Ursus.
item.babel.coin_operated_toy.description: Attack speed +3.25% for every 5 Originium Ingots in the backpack.
No idea why anyone would like a design like this, but its overall concept is indeed praiseworthy–Just insert a coin, and even a statue will start moving. There is nothing truer in this world.
item.babel.blaze_chainsaw.description_0: When enemies are damaged by friendly units, the closer they are to the damage source, the more damage they take (up to +100%)
item.babel.blaze_chainsaw.description_1: She drags herself into hell with her enemies, appraising each other's determination with heat. She has never failed.
item.babel.standard_riot_gear.descriptio: Deals an extra 20% of the damage as Arts damage
Standard equipment of the Ursus Guard. Comes with an intermittent blinding Originium Arts effect. Unfortunately, not many Guards out there remember this when push comes to shove.
item.babel.empty_fowlbeast.description_0: Nearby pets gain 30% max. health and 30% attack damage, and their owner gains 60% attack damage while a pet is present (does not stack)
item.babel.empty_fowlbeast.description_1: The body is long since gone, but the soul remains in the shell for eternity. The unmelting creatures in the branches and leaves carry icicles as they spread their wings in the forest.
item.babel.timeworn_poetry_strips.descri: Nearby pets gain 30% max. health and 30% attack damage, and take 99% less damage from their owner
\"Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.\"
item.babel.rusted_razor.description_0: Nearby enemy units take 15% more physical damage
item.babel.rusted_razor.description_1: If you cut yourself with this, you know what will happen.
item.babel.fissured_restraints.descripti: It seems this sturdy band was once used to restrain something terrifying... Help...
item.babel.rosmontis_embrace.description: Nearby enemy units' max. health -10%, defense -20%
item.babel.gold_plated_dice.description_: The gold-plated die has one side representing life. As for the other nineteen sides...
item.babel.emperors_favor.description_0: The player deals 15% more melee attack damage
item.babel.emperors_favor.description_1: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.
item.babel.frozen_claw.description_0: Nearby enemy units' attack, defense, and max. health +12%; Boss units additionally gain +16% attack and defense, +20% max. health
item.babel.frozen_claw.description_1: Even though explorers such as Magallan challenged this pure white land from generation to generation, there are still countless mysteries... and terrifying truths buried beneath the eternal tundra.
item.babel.lakebed_aegis.description_0: Grants 1 shield on use; while shield is held, max. health +60%
item.babel.lakebed_aegis.description_1: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.
block.babel.king_pedestal.description_0: Sneak-use a king relic to place the pedestal with the relic inside. Right-click to take the relic back, and the pedestal will break itself.
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_0: Saints, knights, and pietists. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_1: Put down and right click with gold ingot to store,
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_2: Right click with empty hand to withdraw.
block.babel.golden_chalice.description_3: Sneak and right click to show balance.
item.babel.coffee_candy.description_0: Gain haste II for 48 seconds when eaten, +6% movement speed
item.babel.coffee_candy.description_1: Dossoles' famous coffee-flavored candy product. Has real caffeine added, to keep you wide awake from clock-in to overtime.
item.babel.orange_storm.description_0: Gain Strength I for 50s when eaten
item.babel.orange_storm.description_1: A Mama John's candy product. The orange flavor, cheap and delicious, is a best-seller among children.
item.babel.dancers_bracelets.description: Grants 10% physical and spell evasion to the player
The audience breaks to an applause as the well-trained dancers waltz around the traps on stage. None of them are aware of the brushes with death the performers just have been through.
item.babel.odd_flute.description_0: Gain 28 exp when used, then Strength for 45s
item.babel.odd_flute.description_1: A weird-looking flute. Someone plays it day in and day out.
item.babel.featured_canned_meat.descript: Gain Regeneration I for 45s when eaten
For travelers on a long journey, the convenience of \"Ready to Eat\" is often more important than taste.
item.babel.spinach_pack.description_0: Gain Strength I for 180s and Speed I for 20s when eaten
item.babel.spinach_pack.description_1: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.
item.babel.wrath_of_siracusans.descripti: Gain Strength III for 5 minutes when eaten

The signature pasta dish of an \"authentic Siracusan restaurant\" that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce, a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver, earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
item.babel.glass_bird.description_0: Gain 4 levels of exp and +1 shield when used
item.babel.glass_bird.description_1: \"In this paradise of mine, the bird will sing forever and ever.\"
item.babel.rescission.description_0: Player gain 4 levels of exp when used
item.babel.rescission.description_1: You can break free of this troupe with just one autograph.
item.babel.rescission.message_1: This entity is not yours, unable to unbind.
item.babel.rescission.message_2: I now untamed, wish you all good luck.
item.babel.rescission.message_3: However, a mere paper won't sway his loyalty
item.babel.old_steam_armor.description_1: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.
item.babel.brilliant_lament.description_: When activated, nearby monsters take +40% Arts damage
His blood yet flows. He has never left this place.
item.babel.scouts_scope.description_0: The farther the target is from the damage source, the more damage it takes, capped at +100% (within 32 blocks)
item.babel.scouts_scope.description_1: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.
item.babel.sea_terror_jerky.description_: When activated, nearby monsters have their armor reduced by 21%
Once their desire to survive overwhelms their terror, the famished Iberians will devour this \"food,\" subsequently turning into Sea Terrors on some ordinary day.
item.babel.cobblestone_altar.description: After killing an enemy, 7.5% chance to permanently increase attack and armor by 5%, stacking up to 10 times
Offer a sacrifice, and receive a reward. It is so convenient that the people never think about what they are directing their sacrifices to.
item.babel.live_rose.description_0: When activated, the holder gains +20% healing effectiveness
item.babel.live_rose.description_1: Is it you who nourish her, or is it her who protects you?
item.babel.knights_code.description_0: Attack speed +5% for every 5 Originium Ingots in the backpack.
item.babel.knights_code.description_1: Taking solemn vows is a thing of the past. The spirit of modern knighthood requires more flexible displays. Go ahead and input your number in the communications device, and you too will be an honorary knight.
item.babel.darknight_whisperer.descripti: When activated, nearby monsters have their max. HP reduced by 10%
A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.
item.babel.godmothers_token.description_: Nearby monsters have their attack damage reduced by 17%

A laurel of bones, the token of a Sicilian noblewoman. This symbol of order will smooth the turbulance of all desires, for conflict is not allowed. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.
item.babel.gaulish_silver_coin.descripti: A coin once circulated in the now fallen nation \"Gaul.\" It is in very good shape, making it highly valuable as a collector's item.
item.babel.gaulish_bank_check.descriptio: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.
item.babel.topographical_map.description: Grants 1 experience level when used, armor +4%
A hand-drawn map that exudes a sense of antiquity. The labels and corresponding terrain have been enlarged, and there seems to be something off about its scale.
item.babel.hand_of_flowing_water.descrip: After using a bow or crossbow, use speed +25%, each finished use grants 1 stack for max 4 stacks, and get emptied if not using for 8s; bows and crossbows no longer consume arrows (including tipped arrows)
The ocean's flow never ceases, because it is always surging.
item.babel.hand_of_pulverization.descrip: Each enemy hit by fireworks fired from your crossbow grants +15% firework damage, up to +150%; the bonus resets after 8s without dealing damage
Your goal isn't just to hit the bullseye over and over.
item.babel.divine_conch.description_1: Sound it, and gods you've never seen or even heard of will answer your call. Actually, it's just a hollow conch shell.
item.babel.flawless_jadestone.descriptio: Even though it thrice brought the city to ruins, it yet shines radiantly in its flawless form. Even today, the Sargon(ian) emperor in possession of the gem has yet to find another piece of jewelry matching its brilliance, leaving it with naught but gunsmoke for a companion.
item.babel.actors_jewelry_box.descriptio: A box containing all kinds of shattered jewelries. The young lead actor wore these jewelries and stepped onto the stage, in the end falling from its highest point.
item.babel.condensed_suppressant.descrip: Deal 150% damage to Infected Creatures and silence them for 3 seconds
A medical reagent developed by Rhodes Island to suppress acute Oripathy infections. However, further enrichment of the reagent's concentration will cause irreversible damage to the infection site.
item.babel.forest_night_whispers.descrip: A special aromatherapy set prepared for field operators by the Convalescent Garden, consisting of fifteen herbal extracts in 172 different combinations. When the wind wends into wooded vales, all creatures lower their voices, and one can find respite.
item.babel.cannot_mark.description_0: Gain 1 experience level for each trade with a Wandering Trader or Cannot
item.babel.cannot_mark.description_1: Some people are willing to do Cannot a favor, and some are worthy for Cannot to do a \"favor.\"
